bullets: Classification is about finding separation boundaries (linear/non-linear):
Regression is more like fitting a curve/surface to the data:

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top in red. Below, a large red-bordered content box containing: first line of text ('Classification is about finding separation boundaries (linear/non-linear):') with 'Classification' in bold blue; to the right of/below that line, two side-by-side scatter plots showing linear and non-linear decision boundaries; then a second line ('Regression is more like fitting a curve/surface to the data:') with 'Regression' in bold blue; below it, a single centered plot showing a fitted curve. Slide number '15' in a yellow circle at top-right corner. Red handwritten annotations over the classification plots.

regions.name: classification plots
regions.content: Two scatter plots side by side: linear boundary (left) and curved boundary (right), with red handwritten annotations

regions.name: regression plot
regions.content: Curve-fitting plot with data points, fitted curve, and red annotation arrows

layout.hierarchy: Red bold title dominates; blue bold keywords 'Classification' and 'Regression' are secondary emphasis; black body text; plots are the main visual content; red handwritten ink annotations overlay the plots.

visual_elements.description: Left classification scatter plot: axes with arrows (no labels/ticks), blue dot points clustered upper-left, red 'x' points clustered lower-right, separated by a straight black diagonal line (linear decision boundary) with a small arrow at its top end. Red handwritten annotation above reads approximately '2nd order' [?].
visual_elements.position: middle, left of the two classification plots

visual_elements.description: Right classification scatter plot: axes with arrows (no labels/ticks), blue dots upper-left region, red 'x' marks lower-right region, separated by a curved black non-linear boundary. Red handwritten annotation to the right reads approximately '3rd order' [?] with an arrow.
visual_elements.position: middle, right of the two classification plots

visual_elements.description: Regression plot: scatter of small open blue/purple circles following a sinusoidal pattern, with a fitted smooth curve (green/yellow line) passing through them and a pink/red shaded confidence band around the curve. Y-axis shows ticks at 1, 0, -1; x-axis shows 0 and 1. Red hand-drawn annotation: a vertical arrow from a peak of the curve down to an 'x' mark on the x-axis, plus a horizontal red line near the top, and a small black arrow pointing to the curve.

imagery: No photos; all imagery is hand-annotated matplotlib-style plots. Red digital ink annotations (handwritten text and arrows) overlay the plots.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title large, bold, red, centered. Body text black with keywords 'Classification' and 'Regression' in bold blue. Slide number in small yellow circle. Handwritten red ink annotations in casual script.
animation_state: Fully built; red handwritten annotations appear to be live ink added during the lecture (not a build state).

Draw a large red-outlined rectangle below the title spanning most of the slide. 5. Inside, add text line: 'Classification is about finding separation boundaries (linear/non-linear):' with 'Classification' bold blue (#0000CC), rest black. 6. Insert two side-by-side scatter plots: left with blue dots upper-left, red x's lower-right, straight black diagonal separator line; right with same point style but a curved black boundary. 7. Add red ink arrows: vertical arrow from curve peak down to an 'x' on the x-axis, horizontal red line at top-left of plot, small black arrow pointing at the curve.
